_note: ED-02, ED-05. The level editor's own tuning numbers. limits: caps the validator enforces on a level file (prims, placed Foamers, triggers, level size in metres, sky image width and height in pixels, a stairs box's most steps). grid: metres a position or a size snaps to. rotateStep: degrees a rotation snaps to. palette: the nine colours the inspector offers. markers: ED-05, how each kind of placed thing is drawn in the view and the colour a pickup takes when the level file says nothing (key colours are fixed, the validator only allows red, blue or yellow). start: the loadout a new level starts with, in data/blasters.json and data/melee.json ids.
